title: reconcile classifies a busy container as unknown even when git says ready-to-merge
description: Noted by the Phase 2 final review (oun) as an observation rather than a bug. classifyWorker in reconcile.ts treats a container busy with something other than the work command as unknown — which is safe, it never redispatches — but it does so even when git already shows that tick branch is ready-to-merge. In that narrow window reconcile escalates to a human for a tick whose evidence is already durable and conclusive. Prefer the durable layer when it is unambiguous.
